newsitem.title: USA: Private Capital offers merger with BHC.
newsitem.headline: Private Capital offers merger with BHC.

text.p: In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission Wednesday, a group led by Private Capital Management Inc said it offered to put together a deal to acquire BHC Financial Inc's outstanding for cash.
In a letter dated October 15, the group said "we believe that a transaction can be structured to acquire all outstanding shares at a significant premium over the closing price on September 30.

The letter said the transaction would be effective in accordance with a corporation to be formed by the group and its investors which would have to be approved by the company's shareholders, the filing said.
The group retained the services of Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom to negotiate a mutally acceptable merger agreement, the filing said.

The group said it is impressed with the management of the company and it currently intends to retain all members of senior management and work with them to structure appropiate equity-incentive programs following the merger.
Private Capital Management Inc holds a 17.07 percent stake in BHC or 1,102,350 common shares.
Bruce Sherman, president of Private Capital Management and Gregg Powers, vice-president also met with BHC's board on October 15 to discuss the merger, the filing said.
